citations.narrative:
Two adult rabbits were housed in the same primary enclosure as six chickens and four ducks. The rabbits appeared to be
in good condition, and while the enclosure provided sufficient space, shelter, and access to food and water, rabbits are a
species that are not permitted to be co-housed with any other species, unless for specific scientific purposes. Housing
rabbits with other species may result in injury or compatibility issues. Correct by ensuring rabbits shall not be housed in
the same primary enclosure with any other species of animals. Correct by: July 17, 2026
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representatives.
This inspection took place at Blooms & Berries, located in Loveland, Ohio.
